scripts.format:backend: prettier --check backend/api/src backend/api/tests frontend/src/services shared/contracts.ts backend/firebase.json
scripts.check:backend: npm run build:backend && npm run typecheck && npm run lint:backend && npm run format:backend
scripts.test:backend: npm run build:backend && firebase --config backend/firebase.json emulators:exec --project demo-petconnect --only auth "npm run test:backend:run"
scripts.emulators: npm run build:backend && firebase --config backend/firebase.json emulators:start --project demo-petconnect --only auth
